paragraphs.text: First the easy part: for beings made of consciousness, being one takes no effort at all. And the thing an ordinary person reflects on is fixed: a knower whose very pith is difference, shining inside non-difference.

Then the mechanics, piece by piece. One reflection never touches another thought, or knowers would multiply. Many things reach oneness through a single shared word, like pot-cloth covering both. A second, helping relation is allowed in — qualifier with qualified — because it serves knowing. Even inside manyness there is twoness, born of double reflection, like a kings whole retinue moving as one and two at once.

King faces his own kind, man faces the masters kind: two facings, one bond. There are three thinkings in play, and the of-relation settles into the qualifier, reaches oneness with what it qualifies, and never loses its own shape.

paragraphs.text: Unity costs the consciousness-bodied nothing. The worldly ones reflection-object is locked: difference-pithed non-difference-shining. That is the setup.

Then the joinery: one thought, un-touched by others. One word — pot-cloth — uniting many. A helping qualifier-qualified relation, admitted because it serves knowledge. Twoness inside manyness, double-reflection-born, like the kings retinue.
Two facings, king and man. Three thinkings. The genitive settles in the qualifier, reaches qualified-oneness, keeps its own form. Nothing lost in the joining.
